# Data Catalog Vocabulary (DCAT)

<!-- Generated from records/dcat.json; do not edit. -->

Vocabulary for interoperable and federated catalogs; resource descriptions are not themselves ownership transfers.

## Identity and normative owner

Record: `dcat`; record authority: Modeling.
Normative owner of subject: [World Wide Web Consortium (W3C)](https://www.w3.org/).
Resource reference: https://www.w3.org/TR/vocab-dcat-3/
Registration is for discovery, not adoption, endorsement, or transfer of normative ownership.

## Editions

- [3](https://www.w3.org/TR/2024/REC-vocab-dcat-3-20240822/): W3C Recommendation. Named edition for identification, not a claim that it is the newest edition.

## Distributions and references

- [dcat-documentation](https://www.w3.org/TR/vocab-dcat-3/) — `documentation`, `text/html`, `en`.
Rights are assessed per distribution in the record. Unassessed rights do not imply permission to redistribute.

## Verification scope

- [metadata-observed](https://www.w3.org/TR/vocab-dcat-3/) (2026-09-17): Landing-page/specification metadata only; no distribution bytes, legal clearance, current-latest guarantee, or implementation conformance was verified.

## Cautions

- Do not classify every specification as a Dataset merely to use dcat:distribution.
- A catalog can be a discovery projection or an explicitly normative inventory; declare which.
